signal: Motivity signed a definitive agreement to acquire Calmanac, expanding into a full all-in-one ABA practice-management stack

email.body1:
Jeff, saw Motivity sign to acquire Calmanac and round out the all-in-one ABA stack.

Expanding the product surface like that means more in-market accounts than reps can research, write to, and follow up on, so signal-to-action latency becomes the bottleneck. Our AI SDR closes that loop autonomously, scaling coverage 3-5x per rep without new headcount, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I built a personalized signal play for Motivity off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jeff, quick follow-up for Motivity.

For RevOps and sales together, the friction is the lag between a signal and a rep's first touch, plus keeping the CRM clean as volume climbs. Drop that latency and the pipeline lift is measurable.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Jeff, last bit of proof for Motivity.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Motivity's reply rate likely compares to other vertical-SaaS teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jeff, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I'll tailor it to Motivity either way.
